raw_snippet: Walmart said Tuesday that it has reached a deal with OpenAI to allow shoppers to buy items directly through ChatGPT.
value_text: Walmart announces a deal with OpenAI to let shoppers buy through ChatGPT (Oct 2025)
note: CNBC, 14 Oct 2025: a deal with one AI company, announced without a date for when shoppers could start; context, not yet an opening to outside agents.

raw_snippet: A federal judge in San Francisco granted Amazon a preliminary injunction Monday blocking Perplexity from using its Comet browser’s AI agent to access password-protected sections of the Amazon website to shop on behalf of customers.
value_text: A court bars Perplexity's agent from password-protected parts of Amazon's site, stayed for an appeal (Mar 2026)
note: GeekWire, 10 Mar 2026: a preliminary injunction in the case already counted, stayed seven days for an appeal; context, not a second move by the platform.
